prerequisites: Complete the source installation on the start page: Node.js 22+, npm, Git, then npm ci and npm run build.
Use Bash on macOS/Linux or WSL, at the cloned repository root. Keep every step in the same terminal.
Use a fresh tutorial project name. If init/create says the project already exists, choose a new slug and update INSTRILO_PROJECT; do not delete work you want to keep.

next.label: Inspect the tutorial fixtures and checks

title: Build your first local TypeScript agent
summary: Start with product guidance, generate a complete project, and run it without a model account.
outcome: A generated TypeScript runtime, a ten-question product brief and an observable offline result.

verification.scope: Every shown command creates, validates, builds, installs and executes a real generated native TypeScript project. The runtime deliberately uses the offline demo provider. The checked-in verify.mjs helper only reads saved JSON and asserts the expected results.
limitations: The offline provider echoes your input. It does not reason about guidance or establish agent quality.
npm preparation downloads dependencies even though the agent makes no model calls.

steps.title: Create a local project
steps.body: This starts in explicit offline demonstration mode. No API key, subscription login or hosted model is needed.
steps.code:
set -eu
INSTRILO_PROJECT=.studio/tutorials/first-typescript-agent
node dist/cli.js init first-typescript-agent --directory .studio/tutorials --language typescript
test -f "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/agent-studio.yaml"
steps.expected: The CLI prints the project path and “Offline demonstration mode”. The manifest exists.

steps.title: Turn ten answers into a product brief
steps.body: The example answers define purpose, users, inputs, outputs, success, tools, boundaries, escalation, examples and operations. Open answers.json to adapt them. Interactive users can omit --answers to answer the same questions in the terminal.
steps.code:
node dist/cli.js guidance create "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/brief" --answers examples/quickstarts/foundations/answers.json
node dist/cli.js config set guidanceDir ./brief "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
node dist/cli.js guidance inspect "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/brief" > "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/guidance-check.json"
node examples/quickstarts/foundations/verify.mjs guidance "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
steps.expected: AGENT-GUIDANCE.md is created and the assertion confirms all ten sections are present. Presence is not a human review of correctness.

steps.title: Generate and prepare the runtime
steps.body: Build writes reviewable agent code and supporting artifacts. Prepare installs this generated project’s declared npm dependencies.
steps.code:
node dist/cli.js validate "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
node dist/cli.js build "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
node dist/cli.js prepare "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
test -f "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/generated/agent.ts"
steps.expected: Validation reports valid: true, build writes generated/agent.ts, and preparation finishes successfully.

steps.title: Run and inspect the offline result
steps.body: An explicit assertion proves which mode ran. The demo prefix is intentional: it prevents an echo test from being mistaken for a useful model answer.
steps.code:
node dist/cli.js run "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" --input 'When can I return an item?' > "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/run.json"
cat "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/run.json"
node examples/quickstarts/foundations/verify.mjs offline-typescript "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
steps.expected: The JSON output contains “[DEMO ONLY] When can I return an item?” and a model trace event.

steps.title: Find every next action from the CLI
steps.body: The CLI includes its own manual and command reference. Move to the independent-connections walkthrough to replace the demo with a tested HTTP connection.
steps.code:
node dist/cli.js explain --list
node dist/cli.js help run
node dist/cli.js help guidance
steps.expected: The offline manual index and complete help for run and guidance print successfully.

troubleshooting: If preparation cannot reach npm/PyPI, fix registry/proxy access and repeat prepare; it does not require model credentials.
If the project already exists, inspect or keep it and choose a new tutorial slug. Do not rerun init over an existing manifest.
cleanup: There is no background service in this walkthrough. Keep the project for experimentation; removing this exact tutorial directory later is optional.
